description: This file implements core functionality for the 'git merge-base' command, including determining common ancestors of commits, handling various options such as 'octopus', 'independent', 'is-ancestor', and 'fork-point', and provides the main command function 'cmd_merge_base' to parse options and execute the corresponding logic.

methods.name: int show_merge_base(struct commit ** rev,size_t rev_nr,int show_all)
methods.description: Computes and displays the merge base(s) for given commits, with an option to show all bases or stop after the first.

methods.name: struct:commit * get_commit_reference(const char * arg)
methods.description: Resolves a string argument to a commit object, aborting if invalid.

methods.name: int handle_independent(int count,const char ** args)
methods.description: Handles the 'independent' mode, listing commits that are not reachable from each other.

methods.name: int handle_octopus(int count,const char ** args,int show_all)
methods.description: Handles the 'octopus' merge base mode, computing merge bases for multiple commits.

methods.name: int handle_is_ancestor(int argc,const char ** argv)
methods.description: Determines if one commit is an ancestor of another.

methods.name: int handle_fork_point(int argc,const char ** argv)
methods.description: Finds the fork point of a commit relative to a reference.

methods.name: int cmd_merge_base(int argc,const char ** argv,const char * prefix,struct repository * repo UNUSED)

ctags.name: cmd_merge_base
ctags.signature: (int argc,const char ** argv,const char * prefix,struct repository * repo UNUSED)

ctags.name: handle_octopus
ctags.pattern: /^static int handle_octopus(int count, const char **args, int show_all)$/

ctags.name: show_merge_base
ctags.pattern: /^static int show_merge_base(struct commit **rev, size_t rev_nr, int show_all)$/
